note: Hand-maintained: what Surge's manual says only in prose, which extract.py cannot read from its headings and tables. Each entry names the page that says it.

tls.note: The types that take the TLS parameters (policies/tls.html): those always over TLS or QUIC, and vmess with tls=true (each protocol's page, Common Parameters and Notes).

no-shadow-tls.note: Types with a server that Shadow TLS does not wrap, besides the QUIC-based ones (policies/tls.html, Shadow TLS).

group-aliases.note: ssid is the legacy keyword of subnet (policy-groups/overview.html, policy-groups/subnet.html).

group-limited.note: Subnet groups take only hidden, icon-url and category of the parameters every group takes (policy-groups/subnet.html).

group-params.note: policy-path, which policy-groups/policy-including.html describes in prose.
